english.title: Driver of Hackney Carriage obstruct / hinder other driver / carriage
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 64 of the Town Police Clauses Act 1847.
english.pointstoprove:
driver of hackney carriage
stood for hire across the street or alongside another hackney carriage OR
refused to give way to another carriage, when conveniently able to do so OR
obstructed / hindered the driver of another carriage in taking up / setting down a person from that carriage OR
wrongfully and forcibly prevented / endeavoured to prevent the driver of another hackney carriage from being hired

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: (i) Section 38 of the Town Police Clauses Act 1847 sets out which vehicles are deemed to be hackney carriages.(ii) Consider also the offences under regulation 103 of the Road Vehicles (Construction and Use) Regulations 1986 of section 137 of the Highways Act 1980.
